newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Top Glory in talks to buy hotel assets.
newsitem.headline: Top Glory in talks to buy hotel assets.

text.p: Top Glory International Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it was discussing the purchase of hotel interests in China from its controlling shareholder.

"Discussions are taking place between the company and Top Glory Holding Co Ltd (TGH), the controlling shareholder of the company, to explore the possibility of acquiring certain hotel interests in the People's Republic of China from TGH," the company said in a statement.
"However, no definite decision has been made by the board to proceed with such acquisitions or on the timing and terms."
Top Glory, which is indirectly controlled by China-backed China National Cereals Oil and Foodstuffs Import and Export Corp (Ceroil), is involved in property investment and food related businesses.
Top Glory shares were down HK$0.01 at HK$1.38 in early Wednesday trade.
